note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2): each figure acts out its word's new hook. Wooden column splits the hall: feminine words left (with the street door, kitchen doors and cellar arch on the back wall), masculine right. Zoom: bar counter on the right wall. One box per item.

items.label: la commande
items.scene: A small boy points like a general, 'I COMMAND!' (koh-MAHND), while the waitress writes his ORDER on her notepad.

items.label: l'addition
items.scene: A waiter ADDS each DISH ON (ah-dee-SYOHN) to a long paper strip: THE BILL, curling down beside the table.

items.label: la crudité
items.scene: Same as English 'crudités' (said krew-dee-TAY): a rabbit nibbles a platter of RAW VEGETABLE sticks with a dip.

items.label: le restaurant
items.scene: Same as English 'restaurant' with a silent t (rehs-toh-RAHN): a smiling host in a bow tie welcomes a family into the RESTAURANT.

items.label: le plat
items.scene: SPLAT! (PLAH) A clumsy duck drops a DISH of spaghetti that lands on the plate with a splash of sauce.

items.label: le serveur
items.scene: Like English 'server' (said sehr-VUHR): a tall WAITER balances three plates along one arm.

items.label: le dessert
items.scene: Same as English 'dessert' with the stress at the end (day-SEHR): a little girl gazes up at a towering chocolate DESSERT.

items.label: le menu
items.scene: Same as English 'menu' (said muh-NEW): a grandfather peers at a huge MENU card through a magnifying glass.

items.label: le pourboire
items.scene: A POOR BOAR (poor-BWAHR) in a patched waiter's jacket beams as a lady drops a coin TIP into his cup.

items.label: le resto
items.scene: A tired hiker takes off her boots to REST her feet (rehs-TOH), sighing 'oh!' in a cosy little RESTO.

items.label: le couvert
items.scene: A bear lays a PLACE SETTING, fork, knife and glass, and pops a silver COVER (koo-VEHR) over the plate.
